اغتنمتا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَنَمَتَا (iḡtanamatā) /iɣ.ta.na.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اُغْتُنِمَتَا (uḡtunimatā) /uɣ.tu.ni.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
